source.title: CPSC, Galoob Toys Inc. Announce Recall of Sky Dancers Flying Dolls

claims.text: The CPSC recall record reports 150 injuries, not thousands.
claims.support: The official recall record says the CPSC and Galoob had received 170 reports of the dolls striking people, resulting in 150 reported injuries.

claims.text: The recall covered about 8.9 million Sky Dancers.
claims.support: The official recall record says about 8.9 million Sky Dancers were involved.

rounds.reason: Official chronology was previously misstated. ESRB Part 8 says the industry formed a trade association four months after the December 1993 hearing and officially formed the ESRB five months after that. Hold pending fresh independent clause-level accuracy admission.

source.title: Content Rated By: An Oral History of the ESRB, Parts 1 and 8

claims.text: Sega and Nintendo were summoned to congressional hearings about video-game violence in December 1993; Mortal Kombat and Night Trap were central examples in the documented lead-up.
claims.support: ESRB's commissioned oral history dates the hearing and reproduces the documented lead-up involving Mortal Kombat and Night Trap.

claims.text: Four months after the first hearing, the industry formed a trade association; five months after that, the ESRB was officially formed in 1994.
claims.support: ESRB Part 8 states the two intervals separately. ESRB's official timeline independently records its 1994 founding.
